title: Scriptura Provenance
description: Provenance for a persisted record. Normative source: BKB-DATA-001 section 4. No orphan records: source_uri, source_kind, content_hash, actor and created_at are mandatory.

source_uri.description: Resolvable locator: URL, DOI, edition plus reference, or dataset plus record identifier.

retrieved_at.description: When the source was consulted. ISO 8601 UTC.

content_hash.description: Cryptographic digest of the content as retrieved, prefixed with the algorithm.

licence_id.description: The licence record governing the source.

actor.description: Who or what created the record.

supersedes.description: Identifier of the record this one supersedes. Provenance is append-only.

normalisation_form.description: Unicode normalisation form of the stored text. Mandatory for original-language text.
